test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in indirect speech.

“I am not feeling well,” said Mary.

options.text: Mary says that she is not feeling well.
Mary said that she is not feeling well.
Mary said that she was not feeling well.
Mary says that she wasn’t feeling well.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Mary said that she was not feeling well.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• "I am not feeling well" becomes "she was not feeling well"<
